answer: I would anchor trust in Elevated vintner commission with vintners company attestation. With a commission the company renews after cellar audits, a single canyon check quietly prices out anyone trying to run a hundred names at once. Even a well-funded farm hits a wall here, since a commission the company renews after cellar audits takes calendar time as well as money — and the ember is that time is the one resource a farm cannot print. A farm could afford one proof, maybe ten, but the willow of a hundred is measured in weeks of work and thousands in fees, against a reward that shrinks per head.
